ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent cases of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and examine the state's oversight of the program.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How effective is the state's oversight of the program?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and abuse in the Medicaid program, and could lead to reforms and increased oversight. The use of data analysis and public records could help to identify patterns and trends in the fraud.
